title: Secrets are empty and GITHUB_TOKEN is read only in workflows run for pull requests from forks
symptoms: Input required and not supplied: token
Deploy previews or coverage uploads fail only on contributor PRs
Comment steps fail with 403 on fork PRs
cause: For pull_request events from forked repositories, GitHub withholds every secret except GITHUB_TOKEN, and that token gets read only permissions.
fix: Run untrusted build steps without secrets, then do privileged work in a separate workflow_run workflow that never checks out fork code.
apply:
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types: [completed]
jobs:
  comment:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "post results here without checking out PR code"
affected: GitHub Actions pull_request events from forks, as of October 2026
